description: A developer skill verification oracle. Validators independently query GitHub's search index and agree on one level: EXPERT, PROFICIENT, BEGINNER or NONE.

studiodev.verified: 18/18 read-only checks, including that the consumer reads THIS oracle ACROSS the contract boundary — get_skill_report answers 'no resolved verification', not 'oracle unreachable'.
studiodev.carries_the_consensus_fix: Yes. _compare_key (mangled to `bd`) and the _apply coherence gate are in the deployed bytes; the level is checked against the agreed counts, not derived from them.

superseded_consumer.why: DO NOT USE. Deployed before gl.get_contract_at was migrated to gl.contract.get_at. It did not fail loudly: SkillConsumer wraps every oracle read in `except Exception` so an unreachable oracle refunds instead of reverting, so the contract deployed clean, reported the right oracle address from get_terms, and silently degraded EVERY lookup to 'oracle unreachable'.

studiodev.fees: studio-dev runs the fee policy ENABLED and exposes no feeManagerContract, so normalizeTransactionFees(undefined) yields an all-zero distribution and the consensus contract refuses the zero-fee transaction. Each deploy passed an explicit estimateFeesDistribution() and cost a 0.1 GEN deposit. Fund with sim_fundAccount, whose amount must be a HEX STRING — a JS Number serialises as 1e+21 and the node answers 'amount must be a positive integer'.
